subject: Tiered weights access & governance — DeltaModels partnership discussion
messages:
From: Elena Korhonen <elena@deltamodels.ai>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Cc: Martin Rojas <m.rojas@consult-ark.com>
Date: 2026-11-21 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Partnership inquiry — controlled weights distribution

Hi Hannah,

Great meeting you at MLInfra Summit last week — thanks again for the quick follow-up. DeltaModels is exploring 1) a vetted distribution channel for select model weights and 2) a tiered access model for partners (audit-only, hosted-only, and licensed-download). We think Redwood's Dedicated + Private offerings map well to our use cases and compliance requirements.

High-level asks from our side:
- Ability to grant partners ephemeral download tokens (time-limited) for licensed weights
- Cryptographic attestations of origin (so downstream recommender partners can verify provenance)
- Clear redistribution rules: define which tiers allow redistribution vs. hosted-only serving
- An option for co-marketing and revenue share on paid bundles

Attaching our suggested NDA and a first-pass access matrix. Would love to run a short call to align on technical feasibility and commercial model. Are you available Wed or Thu next week?

Thanks,
Elena
Head of Partnerships, DeltaModels
attachments: delta_nda_v3.pdf, access-tier-specs.xlsx

From: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Korhonen <elena@deltamodels.ai>
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.ai, sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai

Elena — thanks for the note and materials. Wed 11/24 10am PT works for me; copying Camila (publisher ops) and Sergio (ecosystem partnerships) to make sure we cover commercial & distribution mechanics.

Proposed agenda for the 30m call:
- Quick intros + GTM goals from DeltaModels (5m)
- Access tiers & technical constraints (ephemeral tokens, attestations) (10m)
- Licensing & redistribution (what is allowed per tier) (5m)
- Commercial model (rev share, listing fees) and next steps (10m)

Can you share any non-negotiable clauses from your side ahead of the call so we can loop legal?

— Hannah
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

From: camila_reyes@redwood.ai
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai, sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-21 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: DeltaModels — access tier sketch

Folks — quick internal write-up before the call. Notes:

1) Access tiers (proposal)
  - Seed (private, hosted-only): Delta provides weights; partners can call hosted endpoints only; no downloads; basic analytics.
  - Audited Partner (hosted + limited download): Partners pass security checklist + signed addendum; download via ephemeral token for validated infra; download logs retained for 2y.
  - Redistribution License (commercial bundle): Full download & redistribution permitted under revenue-share agreement and attribution clause; watermarking or embedded provenance recommended.

2) Technical controls we should validate on call
  - Ephemeral download tokens scoped by model_id, partner_id, expiration, and signed by Redwood KMS
  - Signed provenance manifests (SHA256 + publisher signature) attached to weight bundles
  - Optional watermarking: embedding unique asset id into final compiled artifacts where feasible

3) Compliance hints
  - Maintain audit logs (who downloaded what when), retention 2 years for audited partners
  - Option to require on-prem replication review for redistribution tier

4) Commercial thoughts (ballpark)
  - Hosted calls: usage price + 10% listing fee (publisher rebate negotiable)
  - Download/redistribution licenses: one-time license fee or revenue share (suggest 70/30 favoring publisher for direct model sales)

Putting this in the call to confirm technical constraints; happy to iterate post-call and hand to legal.

— Camila

From: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
To: camila_reyes@redwood.ai, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-23 08:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Internal: DeltaModels — access tier sketch

Agree with the tier breakdown. A few pragmatic additions from deals perspective:

- For audited partner downloads we require SOC2 Type II or equivalent, or a security attestation completed by our solutions team.
- For redistribution tier: require a minimum commitment (e.g., first-year $50k list or guaranteed royalties) to justify infra & legal onboarding.
- Rev share: propose 75/25 to publisher for direct license sales; for bundled marketplace listings, 60/40 after platform & credit card fees.
- Escrowed hashes: we should keep a notarized hash on our side to quickly validate claims of origin in takedown/dispute scenarios.

Also flagging pricing ops: Laura, can your team prepare a template revenue-share term sheet we can reuse?

— Sergio

From: Elena Korhonen <elena@deltamodels.ai>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Cc: Legal Ops <legal@deltamodels.ai>, Martin Rojas <m.rojas@consult-ark.com>
Date: 2026-11-24 10:37:00 -0800
Subject: DeltaModels — redline & DocuSign link

Hannah — appreciated the call earlier. We like the tier framing; attaching a redline with a couple of mandatory items from our side (must-have):
- No redistribution for the first 12 months unless mutually agreed
- Redistribution requires attribution and a provenance manifest
- DeltaModels requires the ability to revoke tokens and require remote wipe for hosted inference if a partner is in breach

I've uploaded the initial CLA/Access Addendum to DocuSign for signature: https://docusign.com/contract/abc123-delta-cla
Redline attached: redline-access-cla.docx

Elena
attachments: redline-access-cla.docx

On Thu, Nov 24, 2026 at 10:15 AM Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks — looking through the redline now. Two quick notes: 1) revocation of tokens we can support via our control plane; remote wipe for hosted inference needs to be scoped (we can pause models and revoke keys, but we should explain runtime constraints). 2) 12 month redistribution moratorium is reasonable as a default.

From: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>

Elena — we signed the CLA via DocuSign and countersigned the Access Addendum; you should have received confirmation. Next steps we agreed on call and reflected in the doc:

- Tech: engineering to validate ephemeral token flows & signed provenance manifests (ticket created, owner: infra-eng).
- Security: onboarding checklist for audited partners (SOC2 attestation or equivalent).
- Commercial: Camila + Sergio to draft a term sheet for redistribution tier (min commitment + revenue share templates).
- Ops: set download retention to 2 years and keep escrowed hashes for provenance.

Links and files for the team: https://drive.redwood.ai/partners/deltamodels/tiered-access-specs (specs), https://hubspot.redwood.ai/deals/DLT-2026-0921 (deal record).

Thanks everyone — I'll loop in legal if any additional redlines surface.

— Hannah
